name: OrbitImages-TS-TW
title: OrbitImages
description: Eight small photos travel continuously around a slanted ellipse, passing behind a two-line title in the middle. The path can also be a circle, square, star, heart, wave or a custom curve.
use: A marketing hero needs motion and imagery around a headline without covering the copy.
avoid: On narrow screens the ellipse squeezes the thumbnails small, and the whole block is hidden from assistive tech.
a11y: The whole block is aria-hidden, so the photo alt text is never announced, and the endless loop ignores reduced-motion settings. (keyboard: n-a, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A wide dark stage holds a thin grey ellipse drawn at a slight tilt, with eight square photo thumbnails spaced along it. Two lines of white type sit in the middle: a bold title above a smaller muted subtitle.
behaves: The photos slide steadily around the fixed ellipse and never stop. Each thumbnail stays upright as it travels, while the central text stays still.
customise: Images, orbit shape, radii, rotation, speed, item size, direction and path styling are props; the centre text is passed as a React node.
weight: light: Eight image nodes drift along offset paths in one infinite tween; no canvas or per-frame code.
